title: Data chart shape morph
summary: A compact data card pulls back as a flat line becomes a moving area chart, then its six points reorganize into a radar plot. The chart earns its final form through one continuous transformation.
use_when: A metric story should progress from simple history to multidimensional comparison
A short silent data-visualization interlude needs one clear transformation
A dashboard feature needs motion without showing a full product screen

look.type_style: regular grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, 2.5 % of frame height

sfx.event: data card pulls back into the surrounding field
line chart reorganizes into the radar plot
chart values advance to the next configuration

structure.shot: A six-point baseline becomes a filled line chart while its rounded data card pulls back to reveal the field
structure.camera: pull-out 1.00 -> 0.42 over 30 fr on springs.cameraOut (overshoot not measurable)
structure.motion: baseline points rise into the first area chart with easings.outExpo over ~8 fr (±0.25 s); card pull-out settles by 30 fr

structure.shot: The six-point area chart advances through changing value windows while its category labels travel with the series
structure.camera: static; the card bounds and centre do not change across the row
structure.motion: points, fill and labels interpolate continuously with easings.linear over 150 fr; per-state timing is not measurable (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: Six line-chart points remap onto a six-axis radar grid; the polygon then cycles through comparison shapes
structure.camera: static; the card bounds and centre do not change across the row
structure.motion: axes assemble and points morph into the radar polygon on springs.ui over ~23 fr (±0.25 s); later shapes use easings.inOutSine over ~15 fr each (±0.25 s)

params.content.title: one short neutral heading for the chart card, at most 3 words
params.content.labels: six short category labels shared by both chart forms
params.content.datasets: ordered six-value arrays that drive the moving line and radar shapes
params.morphAt: frame where the line chart starts reorganizing into the radar chart
params.palette: optional brand-derived overrides for field, glow, card, chart, grid and text colours

notes: No hard cuts; one soft frame-in-frame transition spans 0.37-0.57 s (frames 11-17). The repeated chart-window scroll is proposed, not used as a vocabulary id. Motion below 0.25 s and overshoot are not measurable from the sheets. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is silent.
